training.targets: unconditional net percent and fill probability, reshaped from causal labels

selection: Fixed shared context+candidate regression; no winner fold, seed, threshold, or portfolio tuning.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; at least30 fills in each scenario.
compute: Local CPU probe only; no cloud upload; research-only and no live approval.
